g.text: Race-Safe Concurrency Architecture · app/booking/engine.py · Multi-Document ACID Transactions
Worker B attempts hold on same slot → Query matches 0 docs → Returns None (Slot Taken!)
Guaranteed reservation while patient confirms service or completes UPI payment · Slot is locked against all other callers
ACID MULTI-DOCUMENT TRANSACTION: async with _transaction() as session
Match: { _id: slot_id, status: "held", hold_owner: op_id, hold_expiry: {$gt: now} }
Mutate: { $set: { status: "booked", booking_id: new_id }, $unset: { hold_owner, hold_expiry } }
Insert: { _id: new_id, slot_id, contact_id, service, status: "confirmed", request_id: op_id }
Commit Transaction · All-or-nothing atomicity guaranteed across both collections
DISTRIBUTED TRANSACTION SPECIFICATION · CONCURRENCY ASSURANCE INVARIANTS

text.tspan: Evaluated atomically at the storage engine layer.
500 simultaneous workers attempting to claim the
same slot results in exactly 1 hold and 499 clean
rejections with zero dirty writes or double-bookings.
Slot state transition (held → booked) and booking
creation are coupled in a single replica-set transaction.
Any transient network failure, deadlock, or duplicate
causes immediate clean rollback with 0 orphan slots.
No periodic background cleaner or cron loop is needed
to reset abandoned holds. The query condition
patient to atomically reclaim the expired slot on-the-fly.
